title: Comprehensive analysis of mitochondria-related genes indicates that PPP2R2B is a novel biomarker and promotes the progression of bladder cancer via Wnt signaling pathway.
summary: Integrated transcriptomic/ML analysis nominates PPP2R2B in bladder cancer; source reports expression and survival associations and experimental assays linking PPP2R2B to Wnt signaling and progression. This supports a specific candidate biology result; mechanistic scope remains limited to the reported models. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
